title: Content Details
content: # **Objective** You can edit the detail on each Content. Manage Content information to be reflected on Tech Pack, Line Sheet, etc. 1. Content Details 2. Permission # **Detail** ### 1) Content Details ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778860521881) | ▶ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778821542169) ---|---|--- 1. **[Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) : **zpac/zprj files are auto-identified as Style. You may choose the Content Type when uploading the file. 2. **Content Name:** Used throughout CLO-SET features including Line Sheet, Tech Pack, etc. You may edit the Content Name anytime by double-clicking on the field. 3. **[Linked Content](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303217993881) / [Notification](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303197105177) / **[**Favorite**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153) : * Linked Content: You can easily check the list of Parent/Child Contents. * Notification/Favorite: Click the bell icon to turn on the notification of this Content. You may also add this to your Favorite list. 4. **[Workflow](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241):** Shows the Workflow of each Content. You may change the Workflow anytime using the drop-down menu. Workflow names can be customized on [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. 5. **[Thumbnail](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303182640921) / ****[Content ID](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) / External ID / External No.** * Thumbnail: Thumbnail images are extracted from the original 3D file when applicable. * Content ID: Unique ID auto-created by CLO-SET and can NOT be edited. You may search the Content using Content ID. 6. **[Category](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049): **Add Content Category to easily search and manage the files. You may customize your Category names and hierarchy on [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack and Line Sheet. 7. **Tags** : Insert Tags on your Content. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack and Line Sheet. 8. **Description** : Enter additional description. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack. 9. [**Score**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303244420889): Score rating of the Content. A numerical value from 1 to 10. 10. **Creator Name & Time** 11. [**Content Information Fields**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617): Manage Content information with customizable fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Fields can be added/edited in [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873). ### 2) Permission **Permission** : All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit Content Details / Viewers are read only
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for managing and editing content details, ensuring accurate reflection in Tech Packs, Line Sheets, and other related materials.

title: Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload)
content: #### Permission(in CLO-SET Group): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778310726937) Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778310936217)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778311077273)Editor, ![Viewer.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778330948505)Viewer with Upload # **Objective** You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET. You may also easily run Render or generate Excel Tech Pack via CLO-SET. 1. Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 2. Render via CLO-SET 3. Tech Pack via CLO-SET **Details** ### 1) Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 1\. 'Share via CLO-SET' from CLO Software. **Option 1** | **Option 2** ---|--- File > Share via CLO-SET ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354185241) | Main Menu ▶ ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354297113) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778345303577) 2\. Once your file is ready to upload, click 'OK'. If you are not signed into CLO-SET yet, you will be directed to Sign In page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778345528985) 3\. Choose the Group/Location in which you want to upload the file, or select an existing file in CLO-SET for a version update. **![directupload.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354908825)** * * * 1) Select the Group you want to upload the file to * 2) You may choose whether or not you want to notify collaborators in your Group. You may also choose to apply Auto Numbering for CLO-SET to automatically name the content. * 3) Upload a new content to an existing Workroom. Click '+MORE' to view the full list. * User must have an upload permission to select Workroom. (permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer with Upload) * Click '+MORE' to view the 'Browse' tab. Only the Spaces to which you have upload permission will be displayed. * 4) Version update an existing content. Select an existing content from your CLO-SET space, and upload the file as a newer version (ex. version 2) instead of a separate content. 4\. Final view in CLO-SET * * For Project/Garment/Avatar upload, you will see the 3D viewer in CLO-SET * ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778346050329) * * ### 2) Render via CLO-SET * * For**Render via CLO-SET** , once the file is uploaded, Render will start automatically. Learn more about CLO-SET Render [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225). *Rendering will be done per your Render Settings in CLO ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778355451161) * ### 3) Tech Pack via CLO-SET * * For **Tech Pack via CLO-SET,** once the file is uploaded, Excel Tech Pack will be downloaded automatically. Learn more about Excel Tech Packs [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303163374105). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778346436633)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778355784601) For more information on how to link your CLO-SET account in CLO, click [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191662617).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to upload 3D project files, render them, and generate Excel Tech Packs using CLO-SET, tailored for users with varying permission levels.

title: Color Preset
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778536522393) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778572032281)Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778537124889) Editor ## **Objective** ## Upload a Color Palette to be shared within your Company space. The Color Preset can be used in CLO-SET configurator. 1. Adding Color Preset 2. Using Color Preset # **Details** ### 1) Adding Color Preset • Group Admin, Company Admin only Upload the .aco/.ase file in Company Settings page. If you don't have access, please contact your Company Admin or Group Admin. 1\. In your Company Space, click 'Settings' > 'Configurator' > Add Color Preset =![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 1.12.58 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778537415193) | ► | ![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 1.13.41 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778572771737) ---|---|--- 2\. Upload the .ase/.aco file, type in the name and description. Then, save 'Click' *Maximum number of colors in the file is 2000. *Each Company can upload up to 3 preset files. ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 5.49.15 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778537922585) \------------------------------- ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 5.50.19 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778588479641) 3\. To delete the Preset file, click the X icon in the upper right corner. Please note that the deleted Preset files are NOT stored in Trash. ### 2) Using Color Preset • Admin/Collaborator/Editor 1\. In Content Page, click 'Configurator' > Color > Custom tab. Select a swatch from the drop-down list. ![content page.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778573671833) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-08-07 at 10.05.09 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778570612633) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-08-07 at 10.07.45 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778570875545) ---|---|---|---|--- 2\. From the Material List, select the Fabric/Pattern you'd like to change. Then, select a color. *Optional: Desaturate the fabric color from the 'Texture' Option to apply/see true-tone colors. ![Screenshot 2023-08-07 at 10.16.36 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778586408473) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-07 at 10.30.09 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778586913305) ---|--- 3\. Go to 'Picker' to find similar Pantone colors or copy the color code. ![Screenshot 2023-08-07 at 10.34.19 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778587357081) | Go to 'Picker' tab 1\. Information of selected color. 2\. Find the color code. 3\. Find similar Pantone colors. ---|--- 4\. Click 'Create' to add CLO-SET Colorway (![Icon Pack \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778623021721)). You may view the new Colorway from the 'Colorway' tab on the right pane. ![Screenshot 2023-08-07 at 10.48.01 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778623497497) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-08-07 at 10.49.09 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778623727257) ---|---|--- 5\. When downloading, select the 'All Colorways' option to download a new .zprj including CLO-SET Created Colorways. ![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 1.17.02 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778638997913) | ► | ![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 1.18.02 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778639205785) ---|---|--- 6\. Create a new Version in CLO-SET including the new Colorway as part of the .zprj file. Find more on [Version Creation](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303180764313) here.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for Company Admins, Collaborators, and Editors to upload and utilize color palettes in the CLO-SET configurator effectively.

title: Edit Space/Content Name
content: # **Objective** Set up your CLO-SET Space. Edit the name of your Space per your needs. 1. Company/Brand 2. Line/Season 3. Workroom/Assortment 4. Content # **Details** ### 1\. Edit Company/Brand Name Go to Company ▶ Setting ▶ General You will be able to change the name of the company by simply typing the new name. ### 2\. Edit Line/Season Name Go to Company ▶ Setting ▶ General You will be able to change the name of the brand by simply typing the new name, you can go to Space and change the season name by simply typing the new name. You can change the name by simply single-click the Space name as well. ### 3\. Edit Workroom/Assortment Name You can change the name of Workroom/Assortment by simply single-click on its name on the Season Page. ### 4\. Edit Content Name Go to Content page and simply type the new Space name in the top left corner of the page. You can change the name by simply double-clicking the Content name as well.
content_description: Easily customize and set up your CLO-SET Space by editing names for your Company, Line, Workroom, and Content to fit your unique needs.

title: Render Preset
content: Render Preset option allows you to provide a uniform Render Setting as a guideline throughout the Company. #### Permission (Add/Change/Delete): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769749529) Company Admin #### Permission (Use): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769749529) Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778790058265)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778755814297)Editor *See below for permission details # **Objective** * [Save as ZVRP from CLO3D](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Add/Change/Delete Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Using Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) * [Render Preset - Properties](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303245952537) # **Details** ### 1) Save as ZVRP from CLO3D * To start using the new Render Preset feature in CLO-SET, you will need a ZVRP file. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770413977) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770671897) ---|---|--- * On CLO3D software, change Render settings you'd like to save using Property Editor (Image/Video, Light, and Render) * Once you are done, click **Save As > Render Properties** to save as **ZVRP** file. * The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties. Scroll down to #4 for the detailed list of properties to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. * A few requirements for CLO-SET: * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 * Image size must be less than 5,000px * Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. ### ### 2)Add/Change/Delete Render Preset * **Company Admin ONLY **\- Managing the Render Preset for each Company can only be done by the Company Admin. If you are a Collaborator or below, please contact your Admin for support. * Click on your **Company > 'Settings' > 'Rendering'** to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. * Click on 'Upload File' to add a Render Preset. You may add up to 32 files. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778770876313) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778775123481) ---|--- * Click on 'Change File' to upload a new ZVRP file. This will NOT affect the previous Render output. The new setting will be used for future Render works. * Click 'Download' to save the ZVRP file. * Click on the 𝒊 icon to view the property details. * Click on X to delete the Render Preset. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778771416729) ### 3) Using Render Preset * Editors or above can utilize the Render Preset for each Content. * On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. * On the drop-down menu, you will see the **Company Preset** (with ![company.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778798655129) icon) * Users may save a Preset for themselves. In this case, the individual user's Preset will be shown at the bottom of the drop-down menu. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778791857433) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799099289) ---|--- * Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon. ### 4) Render Preset - Properties Please find the full list of Render Property to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. **Image/Video Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778772254233) | * Image Type (image/ turntable) * Colorway * View Point * Image Format * Image Size * Unit (px/in/mm/cm) * Resolution * Color * Texture * Crop | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799426073) ---|---|---|--- For Turntable Image * Image Count * Rotation Angle * Rotation Axis * Direction * Save Video * Save GIF * Total Duration * Frame Duration * Video Format | ![Screenshot 2023-12-15 at 10.35.06 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778799697817) **Light Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778792888601) | * Preset * Rectangle Light * Sphere Light * Directional Light * Spot Light * IES Light * Dome Light | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778793061785) **Render Property** | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778789581721) | * Noise Threshold * Seam Puckering Intensity * Light * Material * Linear Workflow * Color Mapping Type * Burn Value | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778777338905)![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778777570841) * A few requirements for CLO-SET: * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 * Image size must be less than 5,000px * Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer.
content_description: The Render Preset page provides guidelines for uniform render settings across the company, detailing permissions for managing and utilizing presets to ensure consistent rendering quality.

title: Embed Viewer
content: # **Objective** Embed Viewer allows you to share the 3D view with the public crowd. Share the link or embed the CLO-SET 3D viewer in external websites. No CLO-SET account is required to view the Embed Viewer. 1. Launch Embed Viewer 2. Share via Link or QR code 3. Embed to External Website # **Details** ### 1) Launch Embed Viewer 1\. From the 3D Viewer, click on the Embed button ![Shape \(6\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778614057369) at the bottom right corner 2\. Click 'OK' on the pop-up modal. **Please be mindful that launching the Embed Viewer will convert your Content to a **Public** status. Anyone with the link will be able to view the Content. Be ware of security implications of Embed Viewer. ![Screenshot 2023-08-22 at 9.50.52 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778643371929) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-22 at 9.45.06 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778628419865) ---|--- 3\. Select show options, logo type, and URL ![Screenshot 2023-08-22 at 9.51.37 AM \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778628670105) * **Show Options** * Show and Hide UI: on the top left of the Viewer. Viewers can turn on/off the avatar and garment. * Colorway: on the bottom of the Viewer. Select whether or not to provide Colorway selection option. Deselect to provide only the Colorway shown on the Viewer. * **Logo** : on the top right of Viewer. Select a CLO-SET logo or remove watermark. * **URL Type** * Link & QR Code: Share the Viewer with a URL or QR code. With this option, you may share the Viewer to anyone including non-CLO-SET users. Save the QR Code with the 'Save' button. * Iframe: With the Iframe link, you can embed the Viewer on your own website. Copy the link and paste it on your HTML page. ![Screenshot 2023-08-22 at 9.53.48 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778615560089) ### 2) Share via Link or QR Code ![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 4.01.29 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778644274201) * To share the 3D Viewer with a link or QR code, select the URL Type * Copy the URL, or save the QR code to share with your partners * Embed Viewer example: <https://style.clo-set.com/embed/a1cb83cf1003499fae8c21b2c6235eab/1/c/0> ### 3) Embed to External Website ![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 5.33.13 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778615924505) * To embed the 3D Viewer to external website, click on 'Iframe' option * Copy the link and paste it on your HTML page. * Once loaded, the Embed Viewer will be shown as below:
content_description: The Embed Viewer enables users to effortlessly share and showcase 3D content publicly through links, QR codes, or by embedding it directly on external websites, all without requiring a CLO-SET account.

title: Favorite
content: # **Objective** Favorite Company Library, Workroom or Content page allows you to mark and group workrooms of your choice for convenient access. Visit [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410857043727) to see how CLO-SET in CLO works, and how to connect your account. Once your account is setup, quickly access your Favorites list in CLO3D's Library. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 4.19.18 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778432147993)
content_description: The Favorite Company Library page streamlines your workflow by allowing you to easily mark, group, and access your preferred workrooms and content within CLO3D.

title: Payment Method & Process
content: # **Objective** Understand how to complete payments on CLO-SET and troubleshooting process. 1. Payment Process 2. Change Card & Billing Address 3. Troubleshooting Payments # **Details** ### 1) Payment Process 1\. Go to <https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing>. Find plan details, and click 'Subscribe' to start. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778165209497) 2\. Start by entering your Payment information. Click on 'Enter Payment Details'. Insert card number, expiration date, security code, along with the cardholder name and address. Then, click 'Confirm'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778187110041) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778187381401) ---|--- 3\. Once the payment info is registered, confirm billed amount, agree to the Terms, and click 'Order' to complete the payment * Subscription amount is based on the Plan Type, and the # of users in your [Group](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). * If you have any carryover balance, it will be reflected on the bill as shown below (#2). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778182229785) 4\. Once the payment is complete, you will see the below page. Start enjoying your subscription. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778172939161) ### 2) Change Card & Billing Address * To change the credit card information or billing address, visit [Console - Summary](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) page. Click 'Change' next to your payment information. * Click 'Change Card' to update card information or billing address. *Console page is accessible for Group Admin and Group Operator only. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778173122457) ### 3) Troubleshooting Payments Payment attempts may fail for several reasons. See below for a list of errors and how to resolve them. 1. [Your Group exceeds the number of Companies or Workrooms available under the plan] * This error is displayed when the Group attempts to downgrade the plan. If your Group's usage exceeds the limits of the selected plan, downgrading cannot be completed. Please[ review the limitations](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) for each plan and make the necessary adjustments. Then, try downgrading again. 2. [There are Addition Credits that your Group should settle before re-subscribing] * This error is due to having unpaid credit balance on your account. As such cases need further review, please contact our [support](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). 3. [Failed to register card information due to card issue] * Please double check your credit card information or billing address. If the issue persists, [contact us](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). 4. [Upon upgrading, any remaining free trial period will be forfeited, and the payment will be charged immediately] * This message is not an error, but a notification. If you are currently on a Trial period, initiating a paid subscription would forfeit the remaining Trial period.
content_description: This webpage aims to guide users through the payment process on CLO-SET, including how to change payment information and troubleshoot common issues.

title: Web Tech Pack (WTP)
content:
#### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778041944473) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778042096537) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778024981913) Editor ### # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778046859161) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- 1. What is Web Tech Pack (WTP)? 2. Requirements & Permission 3. WTP Tabs & Data * [Overview](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303217248665) * [BOM](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303192584601) * Construction * [Measurement](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219189785) * Cost Estimtaion 4. WTP Version Update 5. WTP Comment ### # **Details** ### 1) What is 'Web Tech Pack (WTP)'? * Web Tech Pack is an **auto-generated Tech Pack** based on your 3D file. Manage production details such as BOM / POM / Cost information, always up-to-date for the whole team. * Information is managed and updated per **Colorway-Grade** combination, for all files uploaded from November 5th, 2024. For other files uploaded prior to this date, please re-upload. ![Screenshot 2023-07-21 at 2.46.38 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778025485977) ### 2) Requirements & Permission * Content Type: for a WTP to be created, the [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) must be 'Style' * if the 1st version uploaded is a zpac/zprj file, then the Content Type will automatically update to 'Style' * if the Content Type is NOT 'Style', then Web Tech Pack will not be activated even if the last version uploaded is a zpac/zprj file. * if the Content Type is 'Styl'e but the uploaded version is NOT a zpac/zprj file (ex. blank content, jpeg, fab, etc), then Web Tech Pack will be activated but it will not be able to load any data. * Access the Tech Pack page by clicking the ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778046859161) (Web Tech Pack) button from Content page * You must have [Admin / Collaborator / Editor](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) permission to view the Web Tech Pack ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778047346329) ### 3) WTP Tabs & Data * #### WTP Tabs **Overview** | View the summary of the Content and manage Schedule. ---|--- **BOM** | Auto-generated BOM per Colorway and Grading. **Construction** | Mark detailed annotation per Fabric, Pattern, Graphic, etc. **Measurement** | POM information including 2D & target measurement for production. **Cost Estimation** | Cost Estimation including Fabric, Trim, Labor, Transportation, etc. * #### WTP data synchronization with Content Page (Editable) Content Information displayed below will be reflected on [WTP - Overview](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303217248665) --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778025859225) | * Content Name * Company / Brand / Season / Line / Workroom * Workflow * Creator/Created Date * Thumbnail * Tags * Category * Description * [Custom Information Fields](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) * ### 4) WTP Version Update
``` ![merge_modal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778060102681) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778047796761)
``` * When you upload a [new version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) of the Style Content, you have an option to update the WTP * If you upload a file format other than .zprj/.zpac as a new version to a[ Style Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), * New WTP information will be reflected on BOM / Construction / Measurement / Cost Estimation. * Once you click 'UPDATE', the Style information in Web Tech Pack will be updated. * If you accidentally press the 'CANCEL' button, you must re-upload the same file. Cancelling cannot be undone. * What does an 'update' to in Web Tech Pack? * If new materials were added to the project file, the new materials will be added to the BOM * If the existing materials have been updated from the software, the updates will be reflected to the new version of the Web Tech Pack * If you have deleted any material on the previous versions of the Web Tech Pack, the new version will EXCLUDE the deleted materials, even if it is included on the new project file uploaded. * Version updates on the Trim files registered on the BOM is NOT reflected automatically * Editing the Web Tech Pack information manually can only be done on the latest WTP version * Once you update the Web Tech Pack version, deleting the new version file from the Content Page will NOT delete the corresponding WTP version. You will be able to review the data, but the WTP will be marked as 'deleted'. ### 5) Web Tech Pack Comment * [Commenting](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171263641) is also available on all tabs. * Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). * Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. * Please follow the [hyperlink](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171263641) to find permissions details ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778060391065)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to the Web Tech Pack (WTP), detailing its features, requirements, and permissions for users to efficiently manage and update their tech pack data integrated with 3D content.

title: Trigger
content:
# **Objective** You can set the triggers and sync URL at Trigger menu. 1. Location 2. Steps * Set Sync * Set Render Trigger * Set Webhook # **Details** ### 1) Location Group Console ▶ Developer page ▶ Trigger ▶Choose a company to set trigger ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778919960601) ### 2) Steps #### **[Set sync]** #### 1\. Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2\. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. 3\. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. #### **[Set Render trigger]** #### 1\. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2\. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. _![renderSett.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778948036249)_ 3\. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style. 4\. Render is then requested. To see in on the page, you need to refresh. _*Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W._ _![renderTrigger.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778920441369)_ #### **[Set Webhook]** #### 1\. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2\. Choose the trigger use case at which you want to fire the trigger. CLO-SET currently offers webhooks for 5 different use cases. \- Workflow: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Content Workflow. \- Invite / Share: You can set a webhook to be fired when a user has been invited/shared to a Space/Content. \- Content Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Content is uploaded. \- Version Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Version is uploaded. \- Colorway Status: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Colorway Status. 3\. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4\. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. **Webhook request body sample for Workflow** ``` { "UpdateTime": "2025-03-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicType": "Style", "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", }, "TriggerType": "Workflow", "TriggerDetail": null, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": "Changed" } } ``` **Webhook body schema** ``` { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": ["WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus"], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }
```
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for setting up triggers and sync URLs within the Trigger menu of the CLO-SET platform.

title: Line Sheet - List Mode
content: ## **Objective** Enjoy an auto-generated CLO-SET Line Sheet that includes everything from Garment Thumbnail to Sales Channel and Price information! #### ✏️ Edit Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778683755033)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778637056537)Company Collaborator #### 👀 View Permission: ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778637056537)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778637356953)Editor or above in respective Space ## **Detail** * What is Line Sheet List Mode? * Access & Permission * Line Sheet List Mode - Table Fields * Export to Excel * Company Settings ## ### 1) What is Line Sheet List Mode? ![Line_sheet_-_List_Mode_4x.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778684694297) CLO-SET provides an auto-generated Line Sheet from the data stored in your 3D garment. Line Sheet List Mode covers information from Thumbnail to Sales Channel, Cost, and Price for a comprehensive review and decision making. ### 2) Access & Permission You may access Line Sheet from various Space level: Company Library, Brand, Line, Season, and Workrooms. Line Sheet will cover all Contents within the respective Space. * Enter the Space > click on 'LINE SHEET' button![LineSheetAccess.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778669258777) Admin and Collaborators may **_edit_** the information within the Line Sheet. Editors or above with access to respective Space (Company, Brand, or Workroom) may **_view_** the Line Sheet. * Minimum Permission to Edit and View Line Sheet of each Space **_✏️ Edit_ Permission** | **Enter Line Sheet from :** | **_👀 View_ Permission** ---|---|--- Group Admin Company Admin Company Collaborator Brand Admin | Company Library | Brand Collaborator or above & Company Library Editor Brand | Brand Collaborator or above Line Season Workroom | Workroom Editor or above Child Workroom ### ### 3) Line Sheet List Mode - Table Fields **Field Type** | **Field List / Explanation** | **Example** ---|---|--- **Non-Editable** | * Thumbnail * Content ID * Company * Brand * Line * Season * Workroom * Creator * Date Created * Date Updated * Content Version * Size | ![nonedit1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778669524249) ![nonedit2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778662607897) Editable by **Content** | * Content No. * Content Name * Workflow * Category * Material Composition * Tag * Description * Customer Type * Product Manager | ![editableCont1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778670091161) ![editableCont2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778673532569) Editable by **Colorway** | * Colorway * Status * Carryover * Quantity * Retail Intro Date * Retail Exit Date * Development Cost * Price * Sales Channel * Store Type * Store Name * Remark | ![editableCol1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778673767833) ![editableCol2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778686472217) **Colorway No.** | This field is editable by user. Assign a unique Colorway No. for easier management. | ![Colorway_No.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778686628505) *Any changes made in Line Sheet will be reflected on the original Content and vice versa. ### 4) Export to Excel You can now export the Line Sheet to an Excel file. On the Line Sheet List Mode view, click the button below to export. ![Excel](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778686845209) ### 5) Company Settings You may customize fields including Category, Workflow, Status, etc. within your Company Settings. You will be able to use the customized options within Line Sheet. * Enter the Company Space > click on Settings ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778698198681) * Customizable fields: Category, Workflow, Status, Customer Type, Sales Channel and Store Type ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778687567001)
content_description: Discover the convenience of an auto-generated CLO-SET Line Sheet that seamlessly consolidates essential garment details, from thumbnails to pricing, for efficient review and decision-making.

title: [Enterprise Plan] Direct upload from CLO Software
content: # **Objective** For Enterprise plan users, You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET and easily share it with other users. 1. Set Preference in CLO3D 2. Direct upload from CLO3D to CLO-SET # **Details** ### 1) Set preference in CLO3D 1\. Sign in to CLO 2\. Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ CLOSET 3\. Enter and modify your exclusive CLO-SET URL. ![image__1_.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778632063257) ### 2) Direct upload from CLO3D to CLO-SET Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Share via CLOSET ▶ Project/Garment/Avatar Main Menu ▶ ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778664089497) ▶ Project/Garment/Avatar 1\. You will be directed to the upload page in CLO-SET. _* If you are not a registered user of CLO-SET, you are directed to the sign up page._ 2\. title: Copy Space Structure
content: #### **Permission** : may vary per scenario. Please see below. # **Objective** With this feature, you can easily replicate the Space Structure to prepare for a new season. 1. [Copy Space Structure](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8351489648527#h_01H6ZS71Q04PPEV3K4FN8RARKE) 2. Copy Company 3. Copy Brand 4. Copy Line/Season 5. Additional Notes # **Details** ### 1) Copy Space Structure * Simply copy any Space from Company to Season along with sub-level Spaces up to the 1st-depth Workroom. * Only the Space Hierarchy will be copied, **NOT** including the Contents within the original Space. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.09.29 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778491077529) * **Basics:** * Go to 'Browse' menu or 'Workspace' to find the Space you want to Copy * On the upper-right corner of the Space, click ••• then click 'Copy Space Structure' * Insert the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * **Only the Space Structure will be copied** without Contents, Categories, and Workflows ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.31 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778475909017) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.25.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476219673) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476467737) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.41 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492075033) ### 2) Copy Company Structure **Permission** : Group Admin only * Go to Workspace > Companies to select the Company to Copy * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Company > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Company Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu * The new Company Space will replicate all Company Settings of the original Company. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.42.51 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778477146521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.25.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476219673) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.45.52 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492822681) ---|---|--- ### 3) Copy Brand Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Company within which the Brand is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Brands * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Brand > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Brand, and select where you want the new Brand to be * You may only choose between Company Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Brand Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492992537) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.52.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778478042521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.53.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493487513) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.24 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493748505) ### ### 4) Copy Line/Season Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin, Company Collaborator, Brand Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Brand within which the Line/Season is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Lines/Seasons * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Line/Season > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and select where you want the new Line/Season to be * You may only choose between Brand Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 8.05.27 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778478952601) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 8.06.40 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778479275929) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.53.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493487513) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 8.04.12 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778494800921) ### 5) Additional Notes Please mind that the Copy Space Structure: * only copies the Space Hierarchy, **NOT** the Contents within * copying the Space between Groups is unavailable * copying Workroom/Assortment level Spaces is unavailable
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to replicate the Space Structure for companies, brands, and seasons within the platform, ensuring a smooth setup for new seasons while clarifying permissions and limitations.

title: CLO-SET in CLO
content: # **Objective** You can link your CLO-SET account in CLO Software to easily access your CLO-SET contents in CLO software. 1\. Add your CLO-SET account 2\. Access CLO-SET contents in CLO 3\. Delete/Change the linked account **Details** ### 1) Add your CLO-SET account in CLO 1\. In CLO 3D's Library section, click on 'CLO-SET' cloud icon. 2\. Click on 'Profile' icon to add your CLO-SET account 3\. Click 'Add Account' and CLO-SET log in browser will pop up. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778214820377) | ▶︎ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778215009433)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778230522649) | ► | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778230764697) ---|---|---|---|--- ## ## ### 2) Access CLO-SET contents in CLO Upon log in, you will see your CLO-SET account on CLO's Library section. Single-click the content to download it. Double-click the downloaded content to load them in CLO. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778254437017) | ▶︎ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778245654297) ---|---|--- ### 3) Delete/Change the linked account ![image.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778254896281) From the CLO3D screen, click on the profile image icon to delete or change your CLO-SET account.
